label: ADVISORY. AI-written explanation of the QorTime referee's results. It does not decide or change the verdict.

explanation:
VERIFIED

Madden27 on PS5, single mode, claimed final away 10 home 0 in quarter 4 by end menu read, final confirmed.

What passed: manifest chain, checkpoint chain, inputs chain and receipt binding recomputed, laptop checkpoint countersignatures valid with gaps and skew within limits, end-of-game menu re-read matches the claimed final, plus challenges, input integrity, motion and video bytes.

The referee checked 166 of 525 video segments in spot-check mode.

The controller-timing advisory was above chance (522‰ vs 447‰). It is advisory only and does not show who played.

Not proven: who was holding the controller, that laptop countersignatures were made live, that footage was not fabricated before hashing, and content of segments not received.

advisory_key.role: advisory only; not a referee key; cannot make or change a verdict
